untagged means no sidewalk tag in OSM, not that there is no pavement.
road_with_pedestrian_mapping_pct = (sidewalk + separate) / road length; roads are trunk..residential and their links, segment midpoints within the radius.
Delhi sidewalk tagging in OSM is sparse; a low value mostly reflects mapping, not safety.
